title: "bcWNV stock passage data analysis"
output: html_document
date: "2026-06-01"

```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(magrittr)
```


## Calculate frequency of each barcode
```{r}

# read the csv file with organized samples
raw <- read.csv('bcWNV_passage.csv')

# Calculate frequency of each barcode within each positive sample
freq <- raw %>%
  mutate(
    passage = as.numeric(passage),
    replicate = as.character(replicate)
  ) %>%
  group_by(passage, replicate) %>%
  mutate(freq = count / sum(count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Replicates present in passages 1-3
reps <- freq %>%
  filter(passage > 0) %>%
  pull(replicate) %>%
  unique() %>%
  sort()

# Stock sample
p0 <- freq %>%
  filter(passage == 0) %>%
  select(sequence, passage, freq)

# Duplicate the stock into each replicate and combine with later passages
plot_all <- bind_rows(
  crossing(
    p0,
    replicate = reps
  ),
  freq %>%
    filter(passage > 0) %>%
    select(sequence, passage, replicate, freq)
) %>%
  complete(
    replicate,
    passage = 0:3,
    sequence,
    fill = list(freq = 0)
  )

# Check that each passage sums to 1
plot_all %>%
  group_by(replicate, passage) %>%
  summarize(total_freq = sum(freq), .groups = "drop")
```


## Visualization
```{r}

# Determine barcode plotting order
barcode_order <- plot_all %>%
  group_by(sequence) %>%
  summarize(
    p0_freq = max(freq[passage == 0]),
    max_freq = max(freq),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    p0_freq,        
    p0_freq == 0,   
    max_freq        
  ) %>%
  pull(sequence)

plot_all <- plot_all %>%
  mutate(
    sequence = factor(sequence, levels = barcode_order)
  )

plot_all$sequence <- factor(
  plot_all$sequence,
  levels = barcode_order
)

# color palette
palette <- c(
  "#E41A1C",  # red
  "#377EB8",  # blue
  "#4DAF4A",  # green
  "#984EA3",  # purple
  "#FF7F00",  # orange
  "#FFFF33",  # yellow
  "#A65628",  # brown
  "#F781BF",  # pink
  "#999999",  # grey
  "#66C2A5",  # teal
  "#FC8D62",  # salmon
  "#8DA0CB"   # lavender
)

cols <- rep(palette, 2000)

# plot graphs
for (r in reps) {
  p <- plot_all %>%
    filter(replicate == r) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = passage, y = freq, fill = sequence, group = sequence)) +
    geom_area(
      color = NA,
      alpha = 1,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(0, 1, 2, 3),
      labels = c("stock", "P1", "P2", "P3")
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 1),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Replicate", r),
      y = "Frequency"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
    theme_bw() +
theme(
  plot.title = element_text(size = 18),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
  axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5)
)

  print(p)
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("Vero_Replicate_", r, ".png"),
    plot = p,
    width = 2.6,
    height = 4,
    dpi = 600
  )
}
```
